title: Microsoft Windows Active Directory - Forest Trusts
description: Trust relationships between Active Directory forests that extend authentication and authorization across forest security boundaries.

implemented-requirements.description: Forest trusts enforce controlled information flow between distinct Active Directory forests. Trust direction explicitly constrains authentication transitivity.
Forest trust boundaries are treated as security boundary extensions requiring compensating controls such as selective authentication and SID filtering.
Authentication mechanisms across forest trusts are explicitly defined and restrict credential replay and unintended privilege propagation.
